meta.parties: In the Matter of the Last Will and Testament of the Late Venasi Ellupalayar, Deceased

rules.statement: The burden of proving the authenticity of a will lies on the petitioner, and they should begin with presenting evidence.
rules.supporting_quote: Where in a proceeding to obtain probate of a will the Judge, on objection raised by the respondent on the petition for probate, frames the issue, 'Did the deceased execute the will or not? '- the burden of proving the affirmative of such issue lies on the petitioner, and ho should begin.
